LanguageData.URT_Rec1: Translates every mod text your language pack does not cover, in the background, without stutter.
LanguageData.URT_Rec2: Free services without any key; if one is busy the next one takes over.
LanguageData.URT_Rec3: Every translation is checked – broken ones are never used (no "ERR" in names and texts).
LanguageData.URT_Status_Counts: Texts without translation found: {0} · remembered translations: {1} · put into the game: {2} · still to translate: {3}
LanguageData.URT_Status_Session: This session: translated {0}, rejected by the check {1}, failed {2} · grammar fallbacks used {3}
LanguageData.URT_Enabled_Desc: Off: only translations already in memory are used, nothing new is sent to the services.
LanguageData.URT_Defs_Desc: Labels, descriptions and other texts of things, buildings, hediffs, research … of every mod.
LanguageData.URT_Keyed_Desc: Buttons, messages and settings texts that mods ship in English.
LanguageData.URT_Rules_Desc: Only the text after "->" is translated; every [token] is kept exactly. A rule that does not pass the check stays in English.
LanguageData.URT_GrammarFallback_Desc: Languages with cases (Czech: imageNom, imageGen …) ask for keywords that mods do not have – the game then writes "ERR". The plain keyword is used instead.
LanguageData.URT_Services_Intro: Services are tried from the top. Switch off what you do not want; free ones work without anything. A service that is busy or blocked pauses itself and the next one takes over. Keys stay only in your settings file.
LanguageData.URT_Badge_AiKey: AI – needs your key or a local server
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.URT_Live_Desc: Messages, letters, buttons, tooltips and info lines that mods write directly in their code (not in language files). They are translated on the screen only – nothing in the game data changes. Known texts appear at once, new English texts are collected and translated in the background (numbers do not matter, "Harvested 25 rice" and "Harvested 3 rice" are one text). Names of colonists, factions and places are never translated.
LanguageData.URT_Status_Live: Live: {0} texts shown translated, {1} collected this session, {2} waiting, {3} arrived
